The NewsBreak Advertising API (NewsBreak API for Business) lets technology companies, direct advertisers and agencies programmatically manage the NewsBreak Ads Manager at scale: create and manage organizations, ad accounts and ad-account users; build campaigns, ad sets and ads; upload creative assets to the NewsBreak CDN; configure audience targeting and inventory platforms; manage account spending caps; read conversion tracking events; and run multidimensional performance reports.

This document was generated by API Evangelist from the operations NewsBreak publishes in its Ad Manager API reference (https://advertising-api.newsbreak.com/hc/en-us). NewsBreak does not publish a machine-readable OpenAPI definition; every path, method, parameter, enumeration and response field here is transcribed from the published reference articles, which are linked per operation via externalDocs.
